name: Turn inquiry emails into leads in Google Sheets with OpenAI and Telegram alerts

parameters.content:
## Turn inquiry emails into leads in Google Sheets with OpenAI and Telegram alerts

**Who's it for:** freelancers, agencies and small service businesses whose leads arrive as plain emails and end up forgotten in the inbox.

### How it works
1. **Check inbox for new inquiries** polls Gmail every 5 minutes.
2. **Skip newsletters and auto-replies** drops mailing lists, out-of-office replies, bounces and ignored senders before any AI call, so you don't pay for noise.
3. **Extract lead details with AI** fills fixed fields: is it an inquiry, name, company, phone, service, budget, deadline, a one-line summary. It is told not to guess.
4. **Check AI answer and score lead** double-checks what the AI returned: the email address is taken from the sender, the budget has to be a real number, and any text that would turn into a spreadsheet formula is neutralized. A lead is **hot** when the budget reaches your threshold or the deadline says urgent.
5. **Add or update lead row** writes to Google Sheets matched on the sender's email: a second email from the same person updates one row.
6. Hot leads also go to Telegram as an HTML-escaped alert with a link to the email.

### Setup
1. Create a sheet named **Leads** with columns: `key, received_at, name, email, company, phone, service, budget, currency, deadline, summary, subject, priority, gmail_link`.
2. Add Gmail, OpenAI, Google Sheets and Telegram credentials; put your spreadsheet ID in **Add or update lead row**.
3. In **Set lead settings**, set your Telegram chat ID, the hot budget threshold and senders to ignore.

### Requirements
Gmail, an OpenAI API key, Google Sheets, a Telegram bot.

### Customization tips
Add fields in **Extract lead details with AI**, or replace the sheet node with your CRM.

## 1. New email, skip the noise
Newsletters, auto-replies and ignored senders stop here, before any AI call.

## 2. AI reads the email
Fixed fields only; the answer is checked before it is saved.

## 3. Save and alert
One row per sender; hot leads go to Telegram.

options.systemPromptTemplate: You read one email sent to a business. Decide whether it is an inquiry from a potential client (a request for a quote, a service, a meeting or a price) and copy the details the sender actually wrote. Do not guess: if a field is not in the email, return an empty string. Copy the budget as written, with its currency. Never invent a name, company or phone number.

attributes.name: is_inquiry
attributes.description: true only if the sender asks for a service, a quote, a price or a meeting; false for invoices, receipts, spam, partnerships offers and support questions from existing clients.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Sender name as they sign the email. Empty string if not given.

attributes.name: company
attributes.description: Company name the sender mentions. Empty string if none.

attributes.name: phone
attributes.description: Phone number exactly as written. Empty string if none.

attributes.name: service
attributes.description: What they want, in a few words, using their words.

attributes.name: budget
attributes.description: Budget amount as written (for example "2,500", "3k"). Empty string if none.

attributes.name: currency
attributes.description: Three-letter currency code of the budget if stated (USD, EUR, GBP). Empty string if none.

attributes.name: deadline
attributes.description: When they need it, copied as written (for example "next week", "by 15 October", "ASAP"). Empty string if none.

attributes.name: summary
attributes.description: One sentence, under 25 words, in the language of the email.
